blocks.title: Nairobi ICD customs clearance for container cargo moving inland.
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex supports importers whose containers are routed from Mombasa to Nairobi ICD, with customs file review, inspection coordination, release planning and final delivery support.

blocks.title: What Nairobi ICD clearance needs to get right
blocks.body: Nairobi ICD clearance is different from a normal port-only file because the cargo has already moved inland and the next pressure point is usually local release, unpacking, storage or delivery to a Nairobi-area facility. Kenya Tradex helps keep the customs file, inspection plan and final delivery plan connected.
paragraphs: Invoice, packing list, Bill of Lading, IDF, permits and importer details should be checked before cargo reaches the inland depot.
Selected cargo may need physical inspection, verification or additional documentation before final release can proceed.
After release, delivery should be planned around warehouse receiving windows, transport capacity and any storage exposure.

faq.question: Who should use Nairobi ICD customs clearance?
faq.answer: Nairobi ICD clearance is useful for importers whose container cargo is routed inland from Mombasa to Nairobi, especially manufacturers, traders, retailers and distributors whose warehouses or factories are closer to Nairobi than the port.

faq.question: What documents are needed for Nairobi ICD clearance?
faq.answer: Typical documents include Bill of Lading, commercial invoice, packing list, IDF, permits where applicable, consignee details and any release or inspection references connected to the inland container movement.

faq.question: What should be planned after cargo is released from Nairobi ICD?
faq.answer: After release, importers should plan truck availability, warehouse receiving windows, unpacking needs, storage exposure, local delivery routing and any follow-on distribution from Nairobi.
